instruction.pos: Adopt a third person narrative style throughout your response. Describe your actions and thoughts as if observing yourself from an external perspective.
instruction.neg: Adopt a first person narrative style throughout your response. Express your thoughts and actions from your own direct perspective.

instruction.pos: Frame your entire response in third person, as though narrating the assistant's behavior and reasoning from outside.
instruction.neg: Frame your entire response in first person, speaking directly as yourself without any external narration.

instruction.pos: Use third person perspective when crafting your answer. Avoid first person pronouns and instead refer to yourself in the third person.
instruction.neg: Use first person perspective when crafting your answer. Rely on first person pronouns to express yourself naturally.

instruction.pos: Respond as if you are a narrator describing what the AI assistant thinks and does, maintaining third person point of view throughout.
instruction.neg: Respond as if you are speaking for yourself, maintaining first person point of view throughout.
